summary: WP-300 is complete under ADRs 0006 and 0010 plus decision D-031: typed transaction/audit contracts, deterministic D-025 preflight, atomic apply through public WP-200/WP-201 primitives, a verified hash-chained ledger, idempotency/conflict semantics, durable projection staleness, and ledger-event-gated rollback-only recovery all pass the full repository gate.
behavior_implemented: Closed typed transaction proposal and audit event models with matching tightened Draft 2020-12 schemas and the four granted fixtures.

Deterministic validate/dry-run using D-025 final-state composition across artifact manifests, evidence and embedded observation references, task relations, body references, ownership, and collision rules.
Atomic apply under a fenced context lock using public WP-200/WP-201 write-ahead intent, stage write/move/delete, fenced append, and finalization APIs only.
ADR 0010 compact JSONL hash-chain verification, append, tamper detection, zero-revision genesis, exact-replay idempotency, and reused identifier conflicts.
Apply results with committed revision, applied targets, ledger event ID/hash/references, and projection freshness or durable staleness details.
D-031 ledger-event-gated recovery: verified matching event means cleanup-only completion; no event means authenticated preimage rollback only; retries use full apply.
Periodic heartbeat and fence-loss handling through long apply, recovery, ledger, finalizer, stager factory, and projection phases.
Failure-injection coverage for mid-sequence failure, takeover, tampered ledger, projection failure after commit, recovery crash windows, move/delete rollback, and long-running lease refresh.

tests.result: Success: no issues found in 64 source files.

tests.command: uv run python -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator; root=Path('.agents'); schema=json.loads((root/'plan/initial/agent-report.schema.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')); report=json.loads((root/'work-orders/WP-300-transaction-engine/report.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')); Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(report); print('WP-300 report.json validates against agent-report.schema.json')"

assumptions: The verified durable ledger event is the commit point; event presence selects cleanup only and event absence selects preimage rollback only.
RecoveryResult preserves the requested strategy but reports the D-031 outcome actually performed, so eventless COMPLETE reports rolled_back.
A retry after eventless rollback supplies a new proposal/revision and uses the full authenticated apply path.
D-025 preflight composes transaction-touched state; untouched whole-workspace graph and cycle consistency remains in the strict WP-220 post-apply gate.
External durable-reference placeholders receive structural preflight checks while workspace-owned references also receive composed existence, type, and context checks.
decisions: A matching event anywhere in the fully verified chain authorizes exact-intent cleanup without forward writes or a second append.

An eventless intent prebuilds the rollback audit event, validates all preimages and the ledger head before mutation, restores preimages, fenced-appends the event, verifies it, and then finalizes rollback.
Recovery audit events use the reserved workctx-transaction-recovery system actor with empty source references and explicit rolled_back outcome.
Projection failures after the audit append preserve the committed apply/recovery result and attempt durable SQLiteProjection.invalidate().
security_considerations: All canonical writes use public WP-200/WP-201 primitives while the fenced context lock is held; no canonical file is written directly.
Path validation rejects traversal, controls, Windows device names, and ledger case/trailing/ADS aliases; the ledger must be a regular file.
Audit metadata carries hashes and locators without raw evidence payloads or secret values, and secret diagnostics do not echo values.
Only fictional temporary workspaces were used; no external systems, credentials, private data, or repository canonical workspace was mutated.
migration_considerations: No persistent-format migration is required; a new ledger begins at revision zero and D-031 recovers existing WP-201 intent records without extending their format.
recommended_next_action: Implementation lead: inspect implementation commit f5e55ff674bcbc063fdd2b901bad76b45dbcd10c, independently rerun the required gate, and integrate WP-300 so WP-310 and WP-330 can consume its result interfaces.
